# VirginM.net
> VirginM.net is a personal website by M. Tim Jones featuring technical articles, software projects, publications, and embedded systems resources.

The site focuses on software engineering, Linux, embedded systems, operating systems, and technical writing, with archives of articles, books, code, and project materials.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://www.virginm.net/): Main landing page for the site and entry point to articles, books, and projects.
- [About](https://www.virginm.net/about/): Background information about the author and the purpose of the website.
- [Contact](https://www.virginm.net/contact/): Contact information and ways to reach the site owner.
- [Site Map](https://www.virginm.net/sitemap/): Overview of the site structure and major content areas.

## Articles
- [Articles Index](https://www.virginm.net/articles/): Index of technical articles covering Linux, embedded systems, and software development topics.
- [Embedded Systems Articles](https://www.virginm.net/articles/embedded/): Collection of embedded systems and microcontroller-related technical articles.
- [Linux Articles](https://www.virginm.net/articles/linux/): Technical writing focused on Linux internals, administration, and development.
- [Operating Systems Articles](https://www.virginm.net/articles/os/): Articles about operating system concepts, kernels, and systems programming.
- [Programming Articles](https://www.virginm.net/articles/programming/): Software development articles spanning languages, tools, and engineering practices.

## Books
- [Books Index](https://www.virginm.net/books/): Overview of books authored or contributed to by M. Tim Jones.
- [Embedded Systems Books](https://www.virginm.net/books/embedded/): Books and related materials focused on embedded development and hardware systems.
- [Linux Books](https://www.virginm.net/books/linux/): Publications related to Linux development, administration, and internals.
- [Operating Systems Books](https://www.virginm.net/books/os/): Book resources covering operating systems and low-level software topics.

## Projects
- [Projects Index](https://www.virginm.net/projects/): Directory of software, hardware, and research projects hosted on the site.
- [Open Source Projects](https://www.virginm.net/projects/open-source/): Open source software projects and related implementation details.
- [Embedded Projects](https://www.virginm.net/projects/embedded/): Embedded hardware and firmware projects with technical notes and resources.
- [Research Projects](https://www.virginm.net/projects/research/): Research-oriented work, experiments, and prototype systems.

## Code and Downloads
- [Downloads](https://www.virginm.net/downloads/): Downloadable code, documents, and supporting materials for articles and projects.
- [Source Code](https://www.virginm.net/code/): Code archives and software examples associated with published technical content.
- [Examples](https://www.virginm.net/examples/): Example programs and sample implementations for learning and experimentation.
- [Resources](https://www.virginm.net/resources/): Supplemental technical resources, references, and supporting files.

## Publications
- [Publications Index](https://www.virginm.net/publications/): Listing of published articles, papers, and other professional writing.
- [Magazine Articles](https://www.virginm.net/publications/magazines/): Articles published in magazines and industry outlets.
- [Conference Papers](https://www.virginm.net/publications/papers/): Papers and formal technical publications by the author.
- [Technical Writing](https://www.virginm.net/publications/technical-writing/): Broader collection of professional technical writing and related references.

## Embedded Systems
- [Embedded Systems Overview](https://www.virginm.net/embedded/): Central page for embedded systems content across articles, books, and projects.
- [Microcontrollers](https://www.virginm.net/embedded/microcontrollers/): Resources related to microcontroller architectures and development techniques.
- [Real-Time Systems](https://www.virginm.net/embedded/realtime/): Content about real-time operating systems and deterministic embedded design.
- [Hardware Interfaces](https://www.virginm.net/embedded/interfaces/): Material on buses, peripherals, and low-level hardware communication.

## Linux and Systems
- [Linux Overview](https://www.virginm.net/linux/): Entry point for Linux-focused writing, projects, and educational resources.
- [Kernel Development](https://www.virginm.net/linux/kernel/): Articles and notes on Linux kernel architecture and development.
- [Systems Programming](https://www.virginm.net/linux/systems-programming/): Resources on low-level programming, processes, memory, and interfaces.
- [Device Drivers](https://www.virginm.net/linux/drivers/): Content related to Linux device drivers and hardware interaction.

## Archive
- [Archive](https://www.virginm.net/archive/): Historical archive of older site content and legacy technical materials.
- [Older Articles](https://www.virginm.net/archive/articles/): Archived technical articles preserved from earlier site versions.
- [Legacy Projects](https://www.virginm.net/archive/projects/): Older project pages and historical implementation notes.
- [Past Publications](https://www.virginm.net/archive/publications/): Archived publication listings and older writing references.
